slices.focus: Caleb shifts from broad corridor clinics to targeted case-tracking on a shorter repeat-loss subsection after proving application clustering to Sharon
slices.summary: Using scanned deed packets, handwritten contact notes, and a cluster map showing where repeat-loss applications were bunching, Caleb convinces Sharon to narrow follow-up onto a shorter subsection. His role shifts from running clinics broadly to tracking specific households through stages toward signed scopes.
open_loops: Build stripped-down tracker for the shorter repeat-loss subsection
Define cooling-off rules (no response threshold, document movement interval)
Add owner column to tracker to prevent all delays becoming Caleb's problem
decisions: Caleb shifted from broad corridor paperwork clinics into a targeted case-tracking role focused on a shorter repeat-loss
